hook: Netanyahu or Eisenkot? Polls can't tell
caption:
🗳️ Israel votes: Netanyahu vs Eisenkot, too close to call. Exit polls land when voting ends at 20:00 UTC.
🇺🇦 Russia strikes Kyiv (at least 1 killed, per Ukraine's emergency service) as a small truce starts in Oleshky.
🤝 Iran hosts Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials, while Houthi missiles target Saudi Arabia.
📈 Anthropic, maker of Claude, files for a Nasdaq IPO. Price not set yet.
🚶 Almost half of London's Oxford Street is now car-free for good.
Which story surprised you most?
